Subject: Post-call: vector rerank priorities, success criteria & next steps

Thanks again for taking time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Call summary (10 min):
- Primary goal: improve search relevance on product pages by re-ranking ANN candidates with a lightweight cross-encoder.
- Key pain: current recall drop at scale (index ~200M vectors) and 95th/99th latency spikes during peak hours (black Friday-like spikes).
- Current stack: Elasticsearch + FAISS on a single retrieval cluster; rerank is an on-device CPU model executed as a blocking step. No caching layer today.

Success criteria you shared:
- Recall@10 >= 0.88 on our canonical eval set
- End-to-end P99 latency < 80ms (95ms tolerable for some queries)
- Cost target: incremental cost per user query (retrieval + rerank) < $0.06
- Deployment constraint: no customer data leaves VPC; audit logs required for each inference request

Observations & short recommendations from Redwood (high level):
- Retrieval layer: FAISS + HNSW is OK, but needs sharding and warm-up for 200M scale; consider IVF+PQ for denser storage and lower memory pressure.
- Rerank: move to a quantized GPU cross-encoder for tail-latency reductions (FP16 / 8-bit quantization); Redwood Optimize can recommend quantization profile automatically by workload.
- Caching: introduce prefix /hot-query cache (Redis or local KV) for high-frequency queries to cut steady-state cost.
- Serving mode: recommend Redwood Dedicated trial (reserved capacity) for predictable P99 under peak; private deployment option available to satisfy VPC/KMS constraints.

Proposed concrete next steps (owners + dates):
1) Share canonical eval set + sample query distribution (you) — due Thu 2026-06-04 — SearchLytics (Samir/Priya)
2) Redwood will run a quick perf estimate for your 200M index + candidate pipeline (soojin) — deliver by Fri 2026-06-05
3) Marissa to schedule a 45-min demo of Dedicated capacity and GPU-based rerank flow (marissa) — schedule by Mon 2026-06-08
4) Monica (CS) to prepare SOC2 / VPC compliance checklist and map to your audit needs (monica) — first pass by Mon 2026-06-08

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: P99s driven by imbalanced query mix (long-tail large prompts). Mitigation: staged rollout + adaptive batching + query-level timeout/fallback to cheaper model.
- Risk: index rebuild cost for IVF/PQ. Mitigation: incremental offline compaction and slot-based rollouts.

Attachments: I’m attaching the SLA template you asked for and I’ll drop the call recording in a follow-up message.

If that aligns, reply with the eval set link and we’ll run the initial perf estimate.

Thanks,
So —
Sojo (Soojin Lee)
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
